semiconductor_relevance: High — Micro-Nano specializes in the sales and distribution of semiconductor equipment and testing instruments, serving various sectors within the semiconductor industry.
summary: Micro-Nano (Hong Kong) Technology Co., LTD is a leading sales and distribution company focused on semiconductor equipment and advanced scientific research instruments. With a strong presence in China and partnerships with top-tier manufacturers, MNT provides high-quality instruments and technical support to customers in the semiconductor and related industries.

regional_presence.China: MNT has established three sales offices in Mainland China located in Beijing, Chengdu, and Shanghai, along with an administrative and logistics center in Hong Kong.
